headline: PLAICRAFT learns your name
lede: Human takes no longer arrive under one anonymous label — consent, recordings and the store now key to the player who gave the YES.

notes.text: The consent gate asks WHO before anything records: saving needs a valid name, declines stay frictionless under an anonymous decline-only id, and the name rides the take file, the upload envelope and the retry queue. Two humans on one phone reach the store as two labels; revoking one purges only that pile. Proof: 193 recordcheck gates plus real-Chrome drives.
New planted mutant collapses the per-name drain predicate — and bites. Hand-mutant proof of the same line went red at exactly the two per-name gates, green on restore.

Caught a pre-existing deterministic harness failure (claptestplay off-tempo #2205) that reproduces identically on pristine main — documented and handed to the QA lane with a cross-referenced note on #2156.

look.text: Answer the new consent gate at Gauntlet — your name keys your takes
